analyzed_vuln.description: `ReadICCProfile` frees a `StringInfo *profile` on short/EOF marker data (`profile=DestroyStringInfo(profile); return FALSE;`) but does not clear `error_manager->profile`, which was set to the same pointer before reading marker bytes. Later, JPEG error recovery in `ReadJPEGImage_` checks `error_manager.profile` and destroys it again, causing a double-destroy/use-after-free observed in `DestroyStringInfo`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must drive the JNX->JPEG path and include an ICC APP2 marker (`ICC_PROFILE`) whose declared segment length is larger than available bytes so `ReadICCProfile` hits the `i != length` error path. This leaves a dangling pointer in `jpeg_info->client_data` (`ErrorManager.profile`), then libjpeg triggers error recovery (`setjmp` path in `ReadJPEGImage_`) which destroys the stale pointer again. The provided PoC does this with truncated ICC data in the embedded JPEG stream.
